_about: The AI models PeakCut can choose between when a job is set to Choose automatically. speed and quality are rated 1 to 5 (5 is best): they are a starting guess, not a benchmark. tier is free or paid. daily_calls is the most calls per day this model may take on this server; 0 means not set, so only the service's own limit applies. Fill daily_calls from the service's own page for its limits, and check each model id with Find models in Settings, AI. Models whose service has no key saved are never used.
